CHEROKEE CREEK PARTNERS, BONNIE HELENE MCANELLY, INDIVIDUALLY
AND AS TRUSTEE OF THE 2025 HOMESTEAD TRUST AND THE BONNIE HELENE
 MCANELLY 2023 TRUST, BERNAREGGIO FAMILY PARTNERS, LTD., ROBERT
          BOWLING, AND WENDELL AND SHIRELY FLEMING’S
 OBJECTIONS AND CORRECTIONS TO SOAH ORDER NO. 30’s ATTACHMENTS

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

          COMES NOW, Cherokee Creek Partners, Bonnie Helene McAnelly, Individually and as

Trustee of the 2025 Homestead Trust and The Bonnie Helene McAnelly 2023 Trust, Bernareggio

Family Partners, Ltd., Robert Bowling, and Wendell and Shirley Fleming (“Movants”) to make

the following corrections and objections to the Attachments in SOAH Order No. 30.

I.        CORRECTIONS TO ATTACHMENT B AND ALJs’ CROSS-EXAMINATION
          LIST
          Cherokee Creek Partners, No. 474 and 475, can be combined and do not need the individual

members listed out, since Cherokee Creek Partners is an aligned intervenor group. 1 Additionally,

Movants want to ensure that Wendell and Shirley Fleming are included in No. 476 as the

previously identified J27, J25, J4 Opposition Landowners and that Braun & Gresham, PLLC is


1
    See PUC Interchange Item No. 3050, Second Amended Notice of Appearance.
 reflected as counsel, instead of Paul Grimme. Movants were not included in the ALJs’ working

list of parties listed for cross-examination. We have contacted LCRA and are working to correct

this; however this will change the previous time allotment calculations discussed at the prehearing

conference.

II.     OBJECTIONS TO EXHIBITS INCLUDED IN ATTACHMENT A

        Party No. 41 – Williamson County – Exhibits A-L

Objection:      Williamson County did not file Direct or Cross-Rebuttal Testimony and as such

                these exhibits were not included. These documents are hearsay and lack the proper

                foundation and authentication to be admitted.

        Party No. 225 – Williamson County Conservation Foundation – Exhibits A-C

Objection:      Williamson County Conservation Foundation did not file Direct or Cross-Rebuttal

                Testimony and as such these exhibits were not included. These documents are

                hearsay and lack the proper foundation and authentication to be admitted.

        Party No. 226 – Florence ISD – Exhibits 2-7

Objection:      Florence ISD filed multiple form direct testimonies. However, Exhibits 2-5 were

                not included in any of those testimonies. These exhibits are hearsay and lack the

                proper foundation and authentication to be admitted. Additionally, Florence ISD

                has identified Exhibits 6 and 7 as HSPM filing and Confidential filing respectively,

                but neither has been uploaded to Egnyte. Movants ask that they not be admitted

                until parties are able to examine the documents and assess their admissibility.




Movants’ Objections and Corrections to SOAH Order No. 30’s Attachments
SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
PUC Docket No. 59475
Page 2
         Party No. 357 – G31 Landowners – Susan Warren - Exhibits 2-7

Objection:       These Exhibits were not included in Ms. Warren’s Direct or Cross Rebuttal

                Testimony and therefore are untimely and lack the proper foundation and

                authentication to be admitted. Additionally, Exhibits 4 and 6 are hearsay.

        Party No. 290 – Estate of Joyce Ann Rundberg – Exhibits 1-29

Objection:      These exhibits have not been uploaded to Egnyte and have not filed on the PUC

                interchange. Movants do not object to Exhibit 4 or any documents that were

                included in the original filing on May 13, 2026. Movants note that Exhibit 4 is titled

                “Affidavit and Statement of Position” but based on the content of the Exhibit and

                the fact that it is sworn to with an Affidavit makes this more akin to Direct

                Testimony. If Exhibits 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, and 8 were not originally included in Exhibit 4,

                Movants object on the basis of timeliness, hearsay, and that they lack the proper

                foundation and authentication to be admitted. Movants do not object to Exhibits 9-

                28, as long as what is admitted is in fact RFI responses. Movants object to entering

                Exhibit 29 as it is marked “Demonstrative”.

        Party No. 366 - Brown Briggs Ranch LLC, Exhibits 1-33, 35

Objection:      Cathylynn Brown filed Direct Testimony for Brown Briggs Ranch, LLC, however

                the exhibits were not included in that Direct Testimony. Therefore, these exhibits

                are hearsay and lack the proper foundation and authentication to be admitted.

        Party No. 374 – Kevin Kennedy, Ex. PA05

Objection:      Movants object because Statements of Position are not to be considered evidence.


Movants’ Objections and Corrections to SOAH Order No. 30’s Attachments
SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
PUC Docket No. 59475
Page 3
         Party No. 433 – Lazy S Ranch – John Bradley

Objection:      Movants believe Mr. Bradley clarified this at the Prehearing Conference, however

                out of an abundance of caution, Movants want to ensure these Exhibits included

                were those from Mr. Bradley’s filings on PUC Interchange Item No. 3921, 4590,

                and 4591, and not his Supplemental Direct Testimony not timely filed at PUC

                Interchange Item No. 5245.

        Party No. 812 - Joe & Michelle Burnett

Objection:      Movants object to Exhibits 1-3 as they are not included in the Burnett’s Direct

                Testimony. The Exhibits are hearsay and lack the proper foundation and

                authentication to be admitted.

                              III.    CONCLUSION AND PRAYER

        For the foregoing reasons, Movants respectfully request that the Administrative Law

Judges strike these exhibits from Attachment A and ask they be excluded from admission into the

record, correct Attachment B as discussed, and any such further relief to which they may be

entitled.


                                                 Respectfully submitted,

                                                 BRAUN & GRESHAM, PLLC

                                                 P.O. Box 1148 (Mailing)
                                                 Dripping Springs, Texas 78620

                                                 512-894-3405 (fax)

                                                 /s/Carly Barton
                                                 Patrick L. Reznik
